sample_job_descriptions.title: Senior Python Developer
sample_job_descriptions.description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our engineering team.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in Python development
- Strong experience with Django or Flask web frameworks
- Experience with RESTful API design and development
- Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
- Experience with Docker and containerization
- Familiarity with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Knowledge of Git version control and CI/CD pipelines
- Experience with unit testing and test-driven development
- Understanding of microservices architecture
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Nice to have:
- Experience with Redis and caching strategies
- Knowledge of Kubernetes
- Experience with GraphQL
- Familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure as code

Responsibilities:
- Design and develop scalable Python applications
- Build and maintain RESTful APIs
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment
- Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
- Deploy and monitor applications on AWS infrastructure

sample_job_descriptions.title: Data Scientist - Machine Learning
sample_job_descriptions.description:
DataMinds Analytics is seeking a Data Scientist with strong Machine Learning skills.

Requirements:
- Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field
- 3+ years of experience in machine learning and data science
- Strong proficiency in Python and R programming
- Experience with machine learning frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn
- Expertise in natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision
- Strong knowledge of statistical analysis and hypothesis testing
- Experience with deep learning architectures and neural networks
- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
- Experience with data visualization tools: Tableau, Plotly, Matplotlib
- Knowledge of big data technologies: Apache Spark, Hadoop
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) for model deployment
- Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms

Nice to have:
- Experience with LLMs, transformers, and generative AI
- Knowledge of MLOps and MLflow
- Experience with A/B testing and experimentation
- Familiarity with Kubernetes for model serving

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy machine learning models for production
- Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering
- Build NLP pipelines for text classification and sentiment analysis
- Create data visualizations and dashboards for stakeholders
- Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate ML solutions
- Stay current with latest research in AI and machine learning

sample_job_descriptions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
sample_job_descriptions.description:
We are hiring a Full Stack Web Developer to build modern web applications.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of full-stack web development experience
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
- Experience with React.js or Angular for frontend development
- Backend development experience with Node.js and Express.js
- Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design
- Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL databases
- Knowledge of RESTful API and GraphQL development
- Experience with Git version control and GitHub
- Familiarity with Docker and deployment tools
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins
- Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodology

Nice to have:
- Experience with Next.js or Nuxt.js
- Knowledge of Redis for caching
- Experience with AWS or Azure cloud services
- Understanding of microservices architecture
- Experience with Tailwind CSS or Material UI

Responsibilities:
- Develop responsive and performant web applications
- Build scalable APIs and backend services
- Implement modern frontend interfaces with React
- Write unit and integration tests
- Participate in sprint planning and code reviews
- Deploy applications using containerized environments
